title: Charge loop
role: meter full: the Discharge meter reached 100% (passive), upper-body overlay; idle/idle-combat accent while the meter waits (hands leave the aim)

title: Charge full
role: meter full: the Discharge meter reached 100% (passive), upper-body overlay; held flourish loop

fails: contact R forearm conductor > R forearm 5.9mm f10

title: Meter full flourish
role: meter full: the Discharge meter reached 100% (passive), upper-body overlay; one-shot (Charge full once, in and out of rest)

fails: contact R forearm conductor > R forearm 6.0mm f10

title: Discharge snap
role: passive Discharge: fires on the next enemy hit at 100%; plays over any state (upper-body layer)

fails: contact R forearm conductor > R forearm 5.5mm f16
